requirements.statement: Merchants can submit a KYC application with business documents.
Applications are screened against a sanctions/watchlist provider before approval.
Approved merchants receive API credentials automatically.
Approved merchants are provisioned a settlement bank account.
Onboarding status is visible in the internal ops console.
Rejected applications trigger a notification to the merchant.

items.architecture_notes: Credential issuance (FR-003) and settlement account provisioning (FR-004) both require the KYC Application Service to have reached an APPROVED state first; neither depends on the other.

services.name: Identity Verification Service
services.description: Document + selfie verification for consumer KYC, not business KYC.

services.name: Notification Service
services.description: Sends transactional email/SMS across the platform.

services.name: Ops Console
services.description: Internal read-only dashboard aggregating service statuses.
